name: Beitong Spartan 2 / Windows normalized XInput
scope: Input intent mapping only. These signs are button choices, not ACT mappings, motor direction settings, physical limits, or motion authorization.
j3_input_scope: RY positive means increasing native J3 intent. Negative intent remains negative for the session planner to accept or reject; +0.093 rad is never used here.

operator_bindings.X: enable a new session or resume current control
operator_bindings.A: return to immutable session origin then disable
operator_bindings.B: GitHub smooth all-axis zero then disable
operator_bindings.Y: return to immutable session origin without disable
operator_bindings.Esc_CtrlC: GitHub smooth all-axis zero then disable
